title: The Lofty Pillars of the Wind-Swept Dunes
intro: Imagine a thriving civilization gifted with towering strength and unmatched skill in building. Settled among vast, curving dunes, this community raised grand landmarks that touched the horizon. Yet pride took root, and a call to return to the worship of Allah alone was met with defiance. What followed remains a warning carried on the wind itself.
clues: We were a powerful nation who came after the people of Nuh, blessed with great stature and strength.
We built lofty towers and monuments on every high place for mere sport and pride.
We boasted, saying who is mightier than us in strength, and we acted tyrannically without mercy.
We rejected our messenger Hud when he called us to worship Allah alone, calling him weak and a liar.
We mocked the warning and challenged him to bring upon us the punishment he threatened if he was truthful.
We were destroyed by a furious, barren wind for seven nights and eight days, left fallen like hollow trunks of palm trees.

outcome.answer: Destroyed by a violent freezing wind for seven nights and eight days

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful." (46:22)
